sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。

sentences.en: This podcast is for English beginner listeners to practice listening to a slow comprehensible English.
sentences.tc: 此播客適合英語初學者聽眾練習聽慢速可理解的英語。

sentences.en: Today I want to talk to you about my week and a story of something scary that happened to me this week. This week.
sentences.tc: 今天我想和大家談談我的一周以及這週發生在我身上的可怕的故事。本星期。

sentences.en: I had a wonderful time. I met some cool people and I made some new friends.
sentences.tc: 我度過了一段美好的時光。我遇到了一些很酷的人，也認識了一些新朋友。

sentences.en: I went to the beach almost every day. Maybe only one day.
sentences.tc: 我幾乎每天都去海灘。也許只有一天。

sentences.en: I didn't go to the beach. But I just love the beach.
sentences.tc: 我沒有去海灘。但我就是喜歡海灘。

sentences.en: I love the salt water. It feels so good for my body. If anything is aching or hurting or sore,.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡鹹水。這對我的身體感覺很好。如果有任何疼痛、受傷或酸痛的情況。

sentences.en: I always take a swim in the ocean or in salt water.
sentences.tc: 我總是在海裡或鹹水中游泳。

sentences.en: I immediately feel better. The only problem is that the waves are massive. The waves in Puerto Escondo are huge.
sentences.tc: 我立刻感覺好多了。唯一的問題是海浪很大。埃斯孔多港的海浪很大。

sentences.en: For example, yesterday I saw some of my old friends from middle school. There is elementary school, middle school and high school.
sentences.tc: 例如，昨天我見到了一些中學時期的老朋友。有小學、國中、高中。

sentences.en: Then university and college. But my friends from middle school are in Puerto Escondido right now. So I went to see them yesterday.
sentences.tc: 然後是大學和學院。但我中學的朋友現在在埃斯孔迪多港。所以我昨天去看他們了。

sentences.en: They are my old friends from my hometown. It had been so long since the last time I saw them,.
sentences.tc: 他們是我家鄉的老朋友。自從我上次見到他們以來，已經過去了很長時間了。

sentences.tc: 他們是非常美麗的朋友。我和他們一起開懷大笑。所以，。

sentences.en: We met up.
sentences.tc: 我們見面了。

sentences.en: They picked me up from my hostel.
sentences.tc: 他們從宿舍接我。

sentences.en: We drove to the beach. to a new beach called Cipol, a new beach for me.
sentences.tc: 我們開車去了海灘。到一個叫 Cipol 的新海灘，對我來說是一個新海灘。

sentences.en: I had never gone there. And at Cipol Beach, the waves aren't that big,.
sentences.tc: 我從來沒有去過那裡。在 Cipol 海灘，海浪沒有那麼大。

sentences.en: You can still swim in the ocean. So with my friends,.
sentences.tc: 你仍然可以在海裡游泳。所以和我的朋友們一起，。

sentences.en: We got into the water.
sentences.tc: 我們進入水中。

sentences.en: We swam for a little bit. I swam and I was just chilling in the water talking to a friend.
sentences.tc: 我們遊了一會兒泳。我游泳了，我只是在水裡和朋友聊天。

sentences.en: When all of the sudden out of nowhere I couldn't feel the sand?
sentences.tc: 當我突然感覺不到沙子時？

sentences.en: I wasn't just floating in the water but I could feel the current pulling me out. Little by little,.
sentences.tc: 我不僅漂浮在水中，而且我能感覺到水流將我拉出水面。一點一點，。

sentences.en: I felt the current pull me out until I couldn't feel the sand at all. And it was getting really difficult to stay in one place. So honestly,.
sentences.tc: 我感覺到水流把我拉了出來，直到我完全感覺不到沙子。待在一個地方變得非常困難。老實說，。

sentences.en: I got a little nervous and I started swimming back a little bit intense.
sentences.tc: 我有點緊張，開始遊回來時有點緊張。
